conclusions: Actual stock Candle and standard Whisper tensors have equal shapes but differ numerically on the unchanged input.
Equal final padding length for this short clip does not imply equal framing: Candle windows start 200 samples / 12.5 ms later than centered Whisper windows.

Candle folds negative-frequency power into positive bins. With zero mel weights at DC/Nyquist, this doubles contributing power, predicting a log10(2)/4 normalized offset before remaining numerical effects.
Matched Torch controls quantify framing/power effects and remaining float32 FFT/window/filter differences; they perform no model decoding.
This feature-only evidence does not establish which difference caused particular word errors. Existing Candle WER 0.50 and independent WER 0.30 both remain failures.
limitations: One fixed licensed formant-speech clip only; no new voice, waveform, model, prompt, threshold or production change.
No weights are loaded and no model is constructed; no new accuracy or speed acceptance claim.
Canonical Candle artifacts were linked read-only, not rebuilt in a clean private Cargo workspace; explicit artifact and Cargo dependency fingerprints are retained.
Analytical controls use Torch FFT/mel arithmetic, not a proof of numerical identity for all possible signals.
